meta.semantics: caller-site EAX computational consumption (RETX-C, strict classes). window: forward from insn after call X until all tracked regs overwritten; mov r2,eax copy extension (<=2 tracked regs); <=12 real instructions; crosses labels and conditional jumps; ends at retn/uncond jmp (after jumptable check)/function end; call kills eax/ecx/edx but tracked copies in ebx/esi/edi survive. excluded identity idioms: xor/sub r,r self-zero; and/or r,r and cmp r,0 pointer-null tests (non-computational). fmt-string content from inline IDA string comment; position-matched when push count == spec count else format-level rule.
exclusions: and r,r / or r,r identity test
partial-reg arith/shift operands (add [m],ax / shr dx,cl) - covered by RU eax-block, not re-emitted here
